title: Fix Warehouse Fulfillment DFD
scenario: This order fulfillment DFD contains three syntax violations: Customer writes directly to "D1 Inventory", "D1 Inventory" copies directly into "D2 Shipments", and Customer communicates directly with Shipping Carrier. Meanwhile, "1.0 Reserve Stock" and "2.0 Dispatch Parcel" are bypassed.
goal: Remove all three illegal shortcuts and route data properly through 1.0 Reserve Stock and 2.0 Dispatch Parcel.
learningObjective: Identify and fix all three forbidden DFD edge types (Entity-to-Store, Store-to-Store, and Entity-to-Entity) in one diagram.
hints: Delete Customer -> D1 Inventory, D1 Inventory -> D2 Shipments, and Customer -> Shipping Carrier.
Route Customer -> 1.0 Reserve Stock, and have 1.0 Reserve Stock update D1 Inventory.
Keep 1.0 Reserve Stock -> 2.0 Dispatch Parcel, and connect 2.0 Dispatch Parcel -> D2 Shipments and 2.0 Dispatch Parcel -> Shipping Carrier.
solutionExplanation: Deleting all three illegal shortcuts and routing Customer -> 1.0 Reserve Stock -> D1 Inventory and 1.0 Reserve Stock -> 2.0 Dispatch Parcel -> D2 Shipments / Shipping Carrier restores a valid DFD.

solutions.description: Valid fulfillment pipeline with all three illegal shortcuts removed

edges.description: Dispatch hands parcel to Shipping Carrier
